definitions.explanation: A government official in charge of a particular area of administration during the feudal era, especially the Edo period. Various types of bugyō oversaw towns, finances, temples, and other domains.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}{奉行|ぶぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{裁|さば}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{勘定|かんじょう}→勘定：02582_kanjou⟧{奉行|ぶぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幕府|ばくふ}→幕府：12448_bakufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}した→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
examples.english: The finance magistrate managed the shogunate's finances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奉行|ぶぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{司法|しほう}→司法：09663_shihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権限|けんげん}→権限：10600_kengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Edo-period magistrates held both administrative and judicial authority.

notes:
USAGE:
A historical term from the feudal era, especially the Tokugawa shogunate (1603–1868). The {奉行|ぶぎょう} system was the backbone of Edo-period administration.

The most well-known types include:
- {町|まち}{奉行|ぶぎょう}: town magistrate (oversaw urban administration and justice)
- ⟦{勘定|かんじょう}→勘定：02582_kanjou⟧{奉行|ぶぎょう}: finance magistrate
- ⟦{寺社|じしゃ}→寺社：12645_jisha⟧{奉行|ぶぎょう}: temples and shrines magistrate
- {遠国|おんごく}{奉行|ぶぎょう}: magistrate of distant provinces

The famous TV series {遠山|とおやま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金|きん}さん features a {町|まち}{奉行|ぶぎょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町|まち}{奉行|ぶぎょう}: town magistrate
- ⟦{勘定|かんじょう}→勘定：02582_kanjou⟧{奉行|ぶぎょう}: finance magistrate
- {奉行所|ぶぎょうしょ}: magistrate's office
